scheme_name: Interim Relief to the Beneficiaries Affected by Disaster (GBOCWWB)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a beneficiary of a scheme of the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
Applicant must be affected by a disaster, catastrophe, or natural calamity.
benefits_summary: Provides immediate relief of up to ₹10,00,000 to eligible beneficiaries.
